<!--
  The simple opening hours (model hours@1): the heading, a description, the address, the phone as a link, the
  address as a link to the map when it has one, and the opening hours as a list (the day or the days and the
  time per row). Axes: layout (columns: the address and the links at the start, the hours at the end from md up;
  stack: one narrow column, placed by the align setting), surface (plain, card: the address and the hours each
  on a card).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { OpeningHour } from "./hours-simple.types";

  export type HoursSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    address: string;
    phone: string;
    phoneHref: string;
    mapHref?: string;
    items: OpeningHour[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    layout?: "columns" | "stack";
    surface?: "plain" | "card";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    address,
    phone,
    phoneHref,
    mapHref = "",
    items,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "columns",
    surface = "plain",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: HoursSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const frame = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "stack" ? "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-8"
    : "grid w-full grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2"
  );
  const panel = $derived(
    (surface as string) === "card" ? "rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border"
    : ""
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="hours-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
      <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={cn("max-w-2xl", selfAlign)}>
        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <Box class={cn(frame, selfAlign)}>
        <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={panel}>
          {#if mapHref}
            <LinkPlain href={urlOf(mapHref)} class="hover:text-primary">
              <Text size="lg" weight="semibold" class={textAlign}>
                {address}
              </Text>
            </LinkPlain>
          {:else}
            <Text size="lg" weight="semibold" class={textAlign}>
              {address}
            </Text>
          {/if}
          <LinkPlain href={urlOf(phoneHref)} class="hover:text-primary">
            <Text size="lg" class={textAlign}>
              {phone}
            </Text>
          </LinkPlain>
        </Stack>
        <Box class={panel}>
          <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", "grid grid-cols-1 gap-2")}>
            {#each items as h (h.id)}
              <ListItem class="flex flex-row justify-between gap-4" data-slot="opening-hour">
                <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {h.day}
                </Text>
                <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                  {h.time}
                </Text>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </Box>
      </Box>
